बॉक्स ऑफिस पर सुस्त रहने के बाद विजय और रश्मिका की फिल्म Ranabaali ने Netflix पर कदम रखते ही बड़ा धमाका कर दिया है! 💥

13 November को स्ट्रीम हुई यह पीरियड ड्रामा 10 दिनों से भी कम समय में 2026 की सबसे ज्यादा देखी जाने वाली साउथ इंडियन फिल्मों की टॉप 10 लिस्ट में शामिल हो चुकी है। 🎬

शादी के बाद और 7 साल के लंबे इंतजार के बाद पहली बार एक साथ आई Vijay Deverakonda और Rashmika Mandanna की जोड़ी को OTT पर दर्शकों का खूब प्यार मिल रहा है। 👫

Netflix के डेटा के मुताबिक, पहले हफ्ते 2.5 million और दूसरे हफ्ते 2.6 million views के साथ फिल्म की कुल viewership 5.1 million पहुंच गई है। यह फिल्म दुनिया भर की टॉप 5 Non-English फिल्मों में भी शामिल हो गई है। 📊

Kareena Kapoor और Prithviraj Sukumaran की फिल्म Daayra के पीछे रहते हुए, Ranabaali भारत, बांग्लादेश, मलेशिया और नाइजीरिया समेत कुल 14 देशों में ट्रेंड कर रही है। 🌍

क्या आपने Netflix पर Vijay Deverakonda की यह फिल्म देखी है, हमें कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर बताएं? 👇

ctx.title: Ranabaali OTT Verdict: Vijay Deverakonda Takes Only 10 Days To Enter Top 10 Most-Viewed South Indian Films Of 2026 On Netflix!
ctx.summary:
Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna's Ranabaali has registered impressive viewership and continues to trend in 14 countries- OTT verdict. 
 The post  Ranabaali OTT Verdict: Vijay Deverakonda Takes Only 10 Days To Enter Top 10 Most-Viewed South Indian Films Of 2026 On Netflix!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna’s latest film, Ranabaali, began streaming on Netflix on November 13. The period drama is set in the pre-independence era. The film draws inspiration from the great famine in southern India during the British regime. It explores an alternate history, with Vijay playing the savior of the town. The film, directed by Rahul Sankrityan, had an underwhelming run at the box office.
The film marked Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna’s first film together after 7 years. It was also their first film together after their marriage earlier this year. The film entered the global top 10 in less than 10 days. It is also among the most-viewed South Indian movies of 2026. In its second week, it ranked in the top 10 in 14 countries.
According to data provided by Netflix, Ranabaali garnered 2.6 million views in its second week. In its first week, the film garnered 2.5 million views. In 2 weeks, the film’s total viewership has reached 5.1 million. The film has entered the top 5 non-English movies globally. It ranks behind Kareena Kapoor and Prithviraj Sukumaran’s Daayra .
With a total viewership of 5.1 million in two weeks, the dramedy has also found a spot among the top 10 most-viewed films on Netflix.
The film continues to remain among the top 10 trending movies in 14 countries. This includes 12 in Asia and 2 in Africa. The film is trending in India, Bangladesh, Bahrain, Kuwait, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Malaysia, United Arab Emirates, Oman, Pakistan, Qatar, Singapore, Mauritius, and Nigeria.
Check out the two-week viewership of the heartwarming drama and its global rank in each week, based on data provided by Netflix.
Note: The viewership numbers are based on the current official data provided by Netflix for the weeks in which these films appeared in the global top 10 non-English charts, regardless of how many days or weeks they had been streaming on Netflix. The overall numbers will vary depending on the cumulative half-yearly viewership data provided by Netflix.
